notes: All your chats in one place. On a computer, tap the Chats tab on the left edge and a sidebar slides in; on a phone, tap the round 💬 button at the bottom and a sheet slides up. It lists every story, Everyone story, group story, group chat, 1-on-1, roleplay and timeline you can continue, newest first, with who's in it, the in-story time and the last line. Tap one to jump straight back in.
